text:
ana: heads up — embedding + rerank helpers in python and go are mismatching server responses. customers report index mismatches when batching.

mike: hmm, repro? sample code?

ana: here's what the sample app did:
```python
# examples/embeds/app.py
vecs = client.embeddings.create(model=\"open-embed-1\", input=[\"a\", \"b\"])
# dev had `first = vecs[0]` and it was a float sometimes
```
server replies seen in logs:
```json
{"data": [0.212, -0.11, 0.9]}  // flattened for single-item, array-of-arrays for >1
```

clara: we used a MultiInput test in CI and hit this too. Go SDK was returning a map[index]vector for rerank while python returned plain list; downstream code expected positional mapping which broke.

sahil: sounds like two separate compatibility issues: shape collapse for len==1 and field name differences (`result` vs `scores` vs `ranking`). Also saw older backends using `embedding` vs `embeddings`.

josh: proposal: SDKs should normalize on a canonical internal format: embeddings -> list[list[float]]; rerank -> scores: [{index,score}] ; accept legacy keys during parsing. Add a small compatibility shim in SDK packagers so clients never see server oddities.

mike: agreed. quick plan: fix parsing layer in each SDK, add a conformance test in the SDK suite that asserts server responses map -> canonical. Will ship patch releases.

ana: additional problem: retry behavior. If a batch partially succeeded and SDK retries whole batch, duplicate outputs can happen because the server doesn't support idempotent per-item semantics now. We need either per-item ids or a batch-id header.

clara: ops note: our staging backend will return 206 Partial Content in one of the mocked failures; SDK currently treats anything non-200 as retryable and resends whole payload. That causes duplicates for idempotent operations.

sahil: for retries we should: 1) attach batch-id + per-item id header, 2) on 5xx, call a status endpoint for batch-id to check which items succeeded, 3) only resend missing items. If status endpoint doesn't exist, fall back to exponential backoff and warn.

josh: adding to the plan: update quickstart examples to iterate over resp.data and not assume resp.data[0] semantics. Right now the tutorial prints resp.data[0] which masks singleton bugs.

mike: I'll open PRs: python parsing shim + tests, go parsing shim + tests, update examples, and a small CLI diagnostic that prints response shapes for debugging. Assigning myself for python and examples; @sahil take go and rerank mapping.

ana: test cases to include: single input flattened, multi input nested, legacy keys (`embedding`, `data`, `embeddings`), rerank `result` vs `scores` vs `ranking`, and simulated partial success with 206.

clara: CI idea: add a conformance matrix job that feeds a set of canned server responses to SDKs and verifies canonicalization. Keeps parity across languages.

sahil: timeline: can we get python patch within 24 hours? customers onboarding now. If we add tests and a hotfix release, yes.

josh: also notify docs that the quickstart will change wording: "iterate over resp.data (one vector per input)" and add a note about batching semantics and idempotency.

mike: small nit: while normalizing, keep a strict mode flag for users who want to see raw server payload for debugging. SDK default should be normalized.

ana: error trace from sample-app logs (sanitized):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "examples/embeds/serve.py", line 68, in <module>
    top_vec = embeddings[0][0]
TypeError: 'float' object is not subscriptable
```

clara: ok that's consistent with flattened vector being returned. Will add a test that asserts TypeError doesn't happen and that shape is always list-of-lists.

sahil: ops question: should server change be made too? Maybe emit a `Content-Shape` response header, e.g., `Content-Shape: [n_inputs,n_dims]` to disambiguate. If server can emit that, SDK can be defensive. But we should not rely solely on server changes.

mike: agreed, prefer SDK-first fixes for faster rollout. Add server header as follow-up RFC.

devex-bot: Please create issues: devex/embeddings-shape, devex/rerank-parity, devex/retry-idempotency. Label: priority/high, area/sdk.

ana: final checklist here:
- [ ] python SDK: parsing shim + unit tests (mike)
- [ ] go SDK: parsing shim + unit tests (sahil)
- [ ] examples/quickstart: iterate resp.data + docs update (mike)
- [ ] CI conformance job (clara)
- [ ] retry design doc + integration test against staging (sahil + ops)
- [ ] server: consider Content-Shape header (follow-up)

mike: starting on the python PR now. Will tag everyone in review. Thanks all.
